featured_reviews.name: dimple nagila
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don’t waste money here. This gym is not worth 1000 rs per month.
They don’t have proper working ACs (only window ACs half of which they keep closed) and it’s ALWAYS hot, when you ask trainers to turn on AC, they make faces as if you’re asking something out of the world. Very very dirty place - a rat died once and smell was there for 4-5 days. I was told “madam hum kya kare”. Least they coud have done was put room freshner without me having to ask. Look at my hands, it’s the dirt from using just the LAT pull down.
Definitely not a place for women. I told them that there should be a female trainer because I work out at 8pm and without a female in sight I feel uncomfortable, they simply refused and said I can either change my time or not come to the gym (unwilling to give refund). The womens washroom floor is ALWAYS wet. Always.
I lost my glove no one gave a shit until I gave a 1 star review, that’s when every trainer came to me to change my review. But when I was begging to look for my glove no one bothered at all. The workout mats are from 1920 and stink so much.
The girl on the reception switches off AC even tho 30 mins are left for closing time. When requested to open, she will rudely say move to the 1st floor (which also BTW is VERY hot).
Horrible experience. Literally started hating gymming because of there dirty, hot, crowded gym with rude trainers.

Within 4 days of joining I asked if I could get a refund because I was clearly uncomfortable with the way they functioned, I even said you can keep 1000 for 4 days if you want, still they didn’t refund.

I usually don’t rant like this, but I hope owner sees this and makes some actual change in the gym. This is not correct.

featured_reviews.name: Bhakti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Welcome to the gym where your workout isn’t the only thing that’ll take your breath away… the smell will too 🤢

The top floor feels like a live experiment on how long humans can survive without AC in Mumbai humidity. Spoiler: not long. And just when you think it can’t get worse, someone generously adds a mystery “relief spray” into the mix—creating a fragrance I can only describe as public toilet meets chemical warfare.

Hygiene? Optional, apparently. Some members treat sweat like a signature—leaving visible “artwork” on machines because napkins clearly didn’t make the guest list.

Honestly, you might join thinking you’ll lose weight… but what you’ll really lose is your mental peace (and maybe your will to come back).

Join at your own risk—especially if you’re fond of fresh air, basic hygiene, or sanity.

Title: Outstanding Gym with Great Potential

Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

I recently joined Sarvadnya Fitness, and I must say, it's been an excellent experience so far. This gym has it all: space, equipment, and a fantastic team. Here's why I think it's the best in terms of price and potential.

First off, the gym is spacious and well-equipped, offering a range of options from cardio to weights and even CrossFit. It's a fitness enthusiast's dream come true. Plus, the affordability factor makes it accessible to everyone.

What sets Sarvadnya Fitness apart is the exceptional owner and staff. They go out of their way to assist you in achieving your fitness goals. Their dedication is truly commendable.

While they are still in the process of setting up, like fixing the AC, it's just a matter of time before everything is in top-notch condition. Their commitment to improvement is evident.

Parking is a breeze with ample space for two-wheelers, and the crowd is decent, creating a comfortable workout environment.

Perhaps the best part is their operating hours. Sarvadnya Fitness is open all day, including Sundays, accommodating even the busiest schedules.

In conclusion, you won't find a better gym in this locality. I can guarantee that Sarvadnya Fitness is on its way to becoming the go-to fitness destination for all. Highly recommended!
